description:
A robotics engineer is designing a custom gearbox input shaft for a 6-axis robotic arm. Create a stepped shaft with three coaxial cylindrical sections as a single Part Design body and save it.

Dimensions (shaft axis along Z, bottom at Z=0):
- Section 1 (Motor coupling): Diameter 8 mm, Height 15 mm (Z = 0 to 15)
- Section 2 (Bearing seat): Diameter 12 mm, Height 25 mm (Z = 15 to 40)
- Section 3 (Gear mount): Diameter 10 mm, Height 20 mm (Z = 40 to 60)

Requirements:
- All sections must be coaxial (same center axis).
- The result must be a single solid body (not three separate objects).
- Total length: 60 mm. Maximum diameter: 12 mm.
- Any modeling approach is acceptable (stacked pads, revolution of a profile, etc.).

Save the file as: /home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/stepped_shaft.FCStd
